children: Database platform provider's fiscal Q2 revenue rose 30% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Shares of the company were down about 12% in extended trading
Company raised full-year fiscal 2027 guidance, citing Atlas momentum
MongoDB raises full-year fiscal 2027 revenue outlook to $2.99 bln-$3.03 bln
Company expects Q3 revenue between $756 mln and $761 mln
MongoDB forecasts full-year non-GAAP EPS of $6.39 to $6.58
ATLAS GROWTH - Co said Atlas revenue rose 29% yr/yr, driving overall performance and prompting full-year guidance raise
ENTERPRISE ADVANCED - Co said Enterprise Advanced and other revenue rose 36% yr/yr, contributing to total revenue growth
AI USE CASES - Co cited early momentum with AI workloads and new retrieval features as supporting demand, per CEO CJ Desai
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 36 "strong buy" or "buy", 8 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the software peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for MongoDB, Inc. is $460.00, about 1.5% above its August 31 closing price of $453.37
The stock recently traded at 67 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 52 three months ago
